description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Order made to impose a Special Commodity Levy on Fish, Green gram, Oranges etc. be valid for a period of 06 months commencing from 08.11.2016
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the imposition and amendment of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders, specifies levy rates for various commodities, and rescinds previous orders. This constitutes legal/regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks, fitting Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) classification.
